posts.headline: Eighteen straight editions of nothing from One Nut Barner, and now Put it in Ra's league-best 20-8 pedigree is sitting at 0-1 with the receipts finally due.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish and 20-8 career record means zero excuses — dropping Week 1 at 123.66 points is exactly the kind of stumble contenders aren't allowed, and the silence is deafening.

posts.headline: Sasinci is 0-1 again and Big Head just posted 101.6 points, the second-lowest score in the league for the second straight week of scrutiny.
posts.detail: A title banner and a 13-15 career record don't mix, and Megamind's threat-to-quit energy is going to get real if this 5.5 average finish turns into a sixth.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh rode a Week 1 win to 1-0, but 120.4 points is the third-lowest total in the league and nowhere near enough to erase a 4-10, dead-last résumé.
posts.detail: The untalented tenth got one crack of daylight — a real GM needs more than 120.4 points to prove last year's 12th-place finish was a fluke.

posts.headline: Peacemakers opened 0-1 at just 95.76 points, and Bubble Guts is picking up right where a middling 15-13 career record left off.
posts.detail: A 4-avg finish team should not be scraping under 96 points in Week 1 — the literal mess of a nickname is starting to feel like a scoreboard preview.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT chose the belt and got whipped — a league-worst 72.02 points in Week 1 is straight fire-and-brimstone territory for the Ultimate Light Skin.
posts.detail: Eli's infamous defensive-player-first draft crime is starting to look prophetic — 72.02 points and an 0-1 start doesn't scream redemption arc for a 13-14-1 career résumé.
